title: fmt wrappers taint output produced by a Stringer/Formatter/error method that discards the tainted value
claim: formatArgumentKey keys arguments by reflect Kind (String / []uint8) and ignores that fmt prints named types through Format/String/Error/GoString. An allowlist type whose String() returns constants yields a fully tainted SQL query built only from constants (false-positive SQLi).
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test -vet=off -count=1 -timeout 15m -run TestReview -v ./iast/propagation/  (with evidence zz_review_fmt.go in iast/internal/propagationtest and zz_review_fmt_test.go in iast/propagation)

title: README advertises fmt.Sprint* without saying only direct string/[]byte operands propagate
claim: Tainted data inside structs, slices, maps, pointers, errors and Stringer wrappers is silently untainted after fmt.Sprint*; README row implies full support.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test -vet=off -count=1 -timeout 15m -run TestReviewFmtUnderTaint -v ./iast/propagation/

title: Coarse fmt/url/strconv output drops all but the first source and marks the whole SQL template as user input; README does not say these are coarse
claim: Sprintf with two same-request sources yields a single [0,len) range from the first source only; exact input ranges are widened to the whole output. Documented as coarse in plans only, not README.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test -vet=off -count=1 -timeout 15m -run TestReviewFmtTwoSources -v ./iast/propagation/

title: Verbs and argument indexes that do not emit the operand still taint the output
claim: %T, %p, %.0s and index-skipped arguments (%[2]s) produce output without the tainted bytes that is nonetheless fully tainted.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test -vet=off -count=1 -timeout 15m -run TestReviewFmtOverTaint -v ./iast/propagation/

title: DroppedPropagation telemetry fires on every Sprint* with >15/16 args even when nothing is tainted
claim: recordDropped() runs before any lookup whenever an analysis is active and the argument count exceeds the budget, inflating the drop counter for clean calls.

title: Fprintf into a tracked strings.Builder silently discards existing builder provenance
claim: WriteString(tainted) followed by an unhooked fmt.Fprintf write marks the writer dirty and String() is untainted; safe miss on a common idiom.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test -vet=off -count=1 -timeout 15m -run TestReviewBuilderFprintf -v ./iast/propagation/
